about: Fixed evaluation set (D-217). Never edit a brief once results exist; add new ones with new ids. expect: planned | out_of_scope | failed. must: feature ids the frozen plan must contain. must_not: feature or capability ids that must not appear among the plan's features. answers: the strict simulated owner's answer key (purpose = baseline id, visitor_actions = feature ids, continue_without_unsupported = yes|no); a question the key does not cover is answered with 'You decide' where allowed, else the recommended option.

briefs.prompt: A website for my accounting firm in Lahore. We do tax returns, bookkeeping and company registration for small businesses. People should be able to send us a message.
Simple site for my plumbing business. Show my services, the areas I cover, opening hours and a WhatsApp button so people can message me.
Website for a dental clinic with our team of dentists, the treatments we offer, a location map and patient testimonials.
Home bakery website. Show our cakes and cupcakes menu with prices and let customers send an order request for custom cakes.
Website for my interior design studio. Portfolio of past projects, a contact form for quotes and a newsletter signup for design tips.
Landing page for a home tuition service for O and A levels. Parents should leave their details so we can call them back. Add FAQs.
Hair salon website where clients can see our services with prices and book an appointment online. Also show a gallery of haircuts.
Yoga studio site: class timetable, our instructors, and people can book a trial class.
Physiotherapy clinic website with appointment booking that takes card payment upfront.
Food blog where I post recipes and restaurant reviews from Karachi, with a newsletter signup.
Website for our community art society showing upcoming events and workshops, past exhibitions gallery and how to join.
Wedding photographer site with my portfolio, packages and prices, client reviews and a blog of recent shoots. Couples can enquire about dates.
I need a website.
Make something nice for my shop.
Website for my business, modern look, blue colours.
Meri kapron ki dukaan ke liye website banao. Naye designs dikhao aur customer WhatsApp pe order kar sakein.
